name: Contact Forms
description: Form builder (Contact Form 7 / WPForms parity): create forms with custom fields, embed them anywhere with the Verso block ContactForms, collect visitor submissions into an admin inbox with unread tracking, CSV export and optional email notification.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the forms and their submissions for the admin inbox, the public form endpoint and the CSV export.
Create the plugin's forms/submissions tables and store visitor submissions.
Serve the admin CRUD/inbox routes and the public form-definition and submit endpoints.
Add the Formularios entry to the admin sidebar.
Send the notification email to the form owner when a new submission arrives.
